mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wecom_msg_log (id, workspace_id, corp_id, agent_id, event_type, touser_text, msgtype, title, payload_json, status, errcode, errmsg, invaliduser, msgid, attempts, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{corpId}, #{agentId}, #{eventType}, #{touserText}, #{msgtype}, #{title}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{errcode}, #{errmsg}, #{invaliduser}, #{msgid}, #{attempts}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, corp_id, agent_id, event_type, touser_text, msgtype, title, payload_json, status, errcode, errmsg, invaliduser, msgid, attempts, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at FROM wecom_msg_log WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, workspace_id, corp_id, agent_id, event_type, touser_text, msgtype, title, payload_json, status, errcode, errmsg, invaliduser, msgid, attempts, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at FROM wecom_msg_log WHERE status IN ('pending', 'failed', 'partial') AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_retry_at LIMIT #{limit}
